actions.name: limited magic immunity
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't be affected or detected by spells of 6th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

actions.name: innate spellcasting
actions.desc: The rakshasa's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). The rakshasa can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: [[/item .ppWAAEul0QHtm4er]]{detect thoughts}, [[/item .A3q2gTNqG6fvNGrv]]{disguise self}, [[/item .Utk1OQRwYkMkFRD3]]{mage hand}, [[/item .oIzA2MEHwxhtQneU]]{minor illusion} 3/day each: [[/item .eS7XnnApoxRxYXPs]]{charm person}, [[/item .ghXTfe7sgCbgf1Q8]]{detect magic}, [[/item .1N8dDMMgZ1h1YJ3B]]{invisibility}, [[/item .nslx2nT3p4lNkmdp]]{major image}, [[/item .zMAWdyc8UVb37BK4]]{suggestion} 1/day each: [[/item .91Sw6vOIaO7U8DvM]]{dominate person}, [[/item .yfbK8gZqESlaoY5t]]{fly}, [[/item .J6Jpw5XzB5aTeqnz]]{plane shift}, [[/item .XzkJpE6XpZfKjODD]]{true seeing}

actions.name: claw
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]], and the target is cursed if it is a creature. The magical curse takes effect whenever the target takes a short or long rest, filling the target's thoughts with horrible images and dreams. The cursed target gains no benefit from finishing a short or long rest. The curse lasts until it is lifted by a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.XZhdgVK3cLoxNCQl]{Remove Curse} spell or similar magic.
